"""Core data model. Everything the engine concludes is expressed as Evidence
objects that point back to character spans of the *original* message, so every
score and every graph link can be audited."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Span:
    start: int  # offsets into the ORIGINAL (un-normalised) text
    end: int
    text: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


class IndicatorType(str, Enum):
    URL = "url"
    DOMAIN = "domain"
    PHONE = "phone"
    IBAN = "iban"
    EMAIL = "email"
    HANDLE = "handle"
    WALLET = "wallet"
    SENDER_ID = "sender_id"


@dataclass
class Indicator:
    type: IndicatorType
    value: str                      # canonical form used as graph key
    raw: str = ""                   # as it appeared in the message
    span: Span | None = None
    role: str = "body"              # body | sender
    linkable: bool = True           # False for shared platforms / official domains
    attrs: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.type.value}:{self.value}"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "type": self.type.value, "value": self.value, "raw": self.raw,
            "span": self.span.to_dict() if self.span else None,
            "role": self.role, "linkable": self.linkable, "attrs": self.attrs,
            "key": self.key,
        }


@dataclass
class Evidence:
    id: str                         # stable rule id, e.g. "tactic.credential_request"
    category: str                   # tactic | url | sender | obfuscation | combo | benign | advisory
    weight: float = 0.0             # log-odds contribution, filled in by the scorer
    spans: list[Span] = field(default_factory=list)
    detail: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    source: str = "rule"            # rule | advisory (advisory = optional ML/LLM, capped)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "id": self.id, "category": self.category, "weight": round(self.weight, 4),
            "spans": [s.to_dict() for s in self.spans], "detail": self.detail,
            "source": self.source,
        }


@dataclass
class VarietyResult:
    """Language variety (dialect) estimate with the markers that produced it."""
    label: str = "unknown"
    scores: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    markers: dict[str, list[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class Message:
    text: str
    id: str | None = None
    sender: str | None = None       # sender id / number as displayed
    recipient: str | None = None    # victim side — pseudonymised before storage
    channel: str = "sms"            # sms | whatsapp | telegram | email | other
    received_at: str | None = None  # ISO-8601
    source: str = "unspecified"     # data provenance: real | synthetic | test | unspecified


@dataclass
class Analysis:
    message_id: str
    language: str
    variety: VarietyResult
    score: float
    verdict: str                    # benign | suspicious | malicious
    logit: float
    bias: float
    evidence: list[Evidence]
    indicators: list[Indicator]
    tactics: list[str]
    brands: list[str]
    fingerprint: int                # template simhash (indicators masked)
    guard_applied: str | None = None
    policy_version: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "message_id": self.message_id, "language": self.language,
            "variety": self.variety.to_dict(), "score": round(self.score, 4),
            "verdict": self.verdict, "logit": round(self.logit, 4), "bias": self.bias,
            "evidence": [e.to_dict() for e in self.evidence],
            "indicators": [i.to_dict() for i in self.indicators],
            "tactics": self.tactics, "brands": self.brands,
            "fingerprint": f"{self.fingerprint:016x}",
            "guard_applied": self.guard_applied, "policy_version": self.policy_version,
        }

            return None
        if tld.isascii() and not match.group("bare").isascii() and "/" not in raw:
            return None                   # Arabic word glued to a latin token; not a hostname

    try:
        parts = urlsplit(raw if scheme else "http://" + raw)
        host = (parts.hostname or "").strip(".").lower()
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if not host or "." not in host:
        return None
    span = t.span(start, end)
    idn = not host.isascii() or any(lbl.startswith("xn--") for lbl in host.split("."))
    try:
        ascii_host = host.encode("idna").decode() if not host.isascii() else host
    except UnicodeError:
        ascii_host = host
    is_ip = bool(_IPV4.match(host))
    sub, registered, suffix, private = ("", host, "", False) if is_ip else psl.split_host(ascii_host)
    path = parts.path.rstrip("/")
    attrs = {"host": ascii_host, "registered_domain": registered, "subdomain": sub, "suffix": suffix,
             "scheme": scheme or None, "path": path, "has_query": bool(parts.query), "idn": idn,
             "ip_host": is_ip, "private_suffix": private, "userinfo": "@" in parts.netloc,
             "port": parts.port if _safe_port(parts) else None}
    out: list[Indicator] = []
    seg = [s for s in path.split("/") if s]

    # messaging deep-links are contact indicators, not web infrastructure
    if registered in ("wa.me", "whatsapp.com") and host != "chat.whatsapp.com":
        num = seg[0] if registered == "wa.me" and seg else (parse_qs(parts.query).get("phone") or [""])[0]
        ph = normalize_phone("+" + re.sub(r"\D", "", num)) if num else None

            out.append(Indicator(T.PHONE, ph[0], raw, span, attrs={**ph[1], "channel": "whatsapp", "via": "link"}))
            return out, (start, end)
    if host == "chat.whatsapp.com" and seg:
        out.append(Indicator(T.HANDLE, f"whatsapp-group:{seg[-1]}", raw, span, attrs={"platform": "whatsapp"}))
        return out, (start, end)
    if registered in ("t.me", "telegram.me") and seg:
        name = seg[1] if seg[0] in ("s", "joinchat") and len(seg) > 1 else seg[0]
        out.append(Indicator(T.HANDLE, f"telegram:{name.lower()}", raw, span, attrs={"platform": "telegram", "via": "link"}))
        return out, (start, end)

    official = official_domains().get(registered)
    shortener = registered in SHORTENERS
    shared = registered in SHARED_PLATFORMS or ascii_host in SHARED_PLATFORMS
    attrs.update(official=official, shortener=shortener, shared_platform=shared)
    canonical = ascii_host + path
    path_is_identity = (shortener or shared) and bool(seg)
    out.append(Indicator(T.URL, canonical, raw, span, linkable=path_is_identity and not official, attrs=attrs))
    out.append(Indicator(T.DOMAIN, registered, raw, span,
                         linkable=not (official or shortener or shared),
                         attrs={"official": official, "shortener": shortener, "shared_platform": shared,
                                "private_suffix": private, "ip_host": is_ip}))
    return out, (start, end)


def _safe_port(parts) -> bool:
    try:
        parts.port
        return True
    except ValueError:
        return False


def extract(cleaned: OffsetText, sender: str | None = None, default_region: str = "SA") -> tuple[list[Indicator], list[Evidence]]:
    evidence: list[Evidence] = []
    t = cleaned
    defanged = []
    for pat, repl in _DEFANG:
        hits = [t.span(m.start(), m.end()) for m in pat.finditer(t.text)]
        if hits:
            defanged.extend(hits)
            t = t.regex_sub(pat, repl)
    out: list[Indicator] = []
    taken: list[tuple[int, int]] = []

    for m in _EMAIL.finditer(t.text):
        dom = m.group(1).lower()
        out.append(Indicator(T.EMAIL, m.group(0).lower(), m.group(0), t.span(m.start(), m.end()),
                             attrs={"domain": dom, "freemail": dom in FREEMAIL}))
        taken.append((m.start(), m.end()))
    masked = _mask(t, taken)
    n_urls = 0
    for m in _URL.finditer(masked):
        parsed = _parse_url(m, t)
        if parsed:
            inds, rng = parsed
            out.extend(inds); taken.append(rng); n_urls += 1
    if defanged and n_urls:
        evidence.append(Evidence("obfuscation.defanged_url", "obfuscation", spans=defanged[:5]))
    masked = _mask(t, taken)

    for m in _IBAN.finditer(masked):
        val = re.sub(r"[ \-]", "", m.group(1)).upper()
        if iban_ok(val):
            out.append(Indicator(T.IBAN, val, m.group(0), t.span(m.start(), m.end()), attrs={"country": val[:2], "bank_code": val[4:6]}))
            taken.append((m.start(), m.end()))
    masked = _mask(t, taken)
    for chain, pat, check in _WALLETS:
        for m in pat.finditer(masked):
            if check and not b58check_ok(m.group(0)):
                continue
            out.append(Indicator(T.WALLET, f"{chain}:{m.group(0)}", m.group(0), t.span(m.start(), m.end()), attrs={"chain": chain}))
            taken.append((m.start(), m.end()))
    masked = _mask(t, taken)
    for m in _PHONE.finditer(masked):
        ph = normalize_phone(m.group(0), default_region)
        if ph:
            ctx = masked[max(0, m.start() - 25):m.start()].lower()
            if re.search(r"واتس|whats|وتساب", ctx):
                ph[1]["channel"] = "whatsapp"
            out.append(Indicator(T.PHONE, ph[0], m.group(0), t.span(m.start(), m.end()), attrs=ph[1]))
            taken.append((m.start(), m.end()))
    tg = bool(_TG_CONTEXT.search(t.text))
    for m in _HANDLE.finditer(masked):
        name = m.group(1).lower().rstrip(".")
        out.append(Indicator(T.HANDLE, f"{'telegram' if tg else 'at'}:{name}", m.group(0), t.span(m.start(), m.end()),
                             attrs={"platform": "telegram" if tg else None}))

    # homoglyph words: Latin mixed with Cyrillic/Greek inside one token
    mixed = []
    for m in _WORD.finditer(masked):
        scripts = {script_of(c) for c in m.group(0)} - {"other"}
        if "latin" in scripts and scripts & {"cyrillic", "greek"}:
            mixed.append(t.span(m.start(), m.end()))
    if mixed:
        evidence.append(Evidence("obfuscation.mixed_script", "obfuscation", spans=mixed[:5]))

    if sender:
        s = sender.strip()
        ph = normalize_phone(s, default_region) if re.fullmatch(r"[+\d][\d \-()]{6,}", s) else None
        if ph:
            out.append(Indicator(T.PHONE, ph[0], s, None, role="sender", attrs=ph[1]))
        elif s:
            out.append(Indicator(T.SENDER_ID, s.casefold(), s, None, role="sender",
                                 attrs={"alphanumeric": not s.isdigit(), "shortcode": s.isdigit()}))
    # de-duplicate by (key, role), keep first occurrence
    seen, uniq = set(), []
    for ind in out:
        k = (ind.key, ind.role)
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k); uniq.append(ind)
    return uniq, evidence

"""Registered-domain resolution.

A compact built-in suffix table (ICANN multi-label suffixes common in the
target region + private hosting suffixes) so the core has no dependencies.
Private hosting suffixes matter for campaign linking: two unrelated scams on
`*.web.app` must NOT be linked through `web.app`. Production deployments can
load the full Public Suffix List with `load_suffix_file()`."""
from __future__ import annotations

_SECOND_LEVEL = ("com", "net", "org", "gov", "edu", "co", "ac", "sch", "med", "pub", "mil", "info", "biz", "name", "or", "ne", "go")
_CC = ("sa ae eg kw qa bh om jo lb iq sy ye ly tn dz ma sd ps tr uk au in pk id my ng za br mx cn jp kr "
       "nz il ir af bd lk np th vn ph sg hk tw ke gh tz ug et ru ua ar co pe ve").split()
MULTI_SUFFIXES: set[str] = {f"{s}.{c}" for s in _SECOND_LEVEL for c in _CC}

# Free hosting / dynamic DNS / tunnelling: every customer gets a sub-domain.
PRIVATE_SUFFIXES: set[str] = {
    "web.app", "firebaseapp.com", "github.io", "gitlab.io", "pages.dev", "workers.dev", "r2.dev",
    "vercel.app", "netlify.app", "herokuapp.com", "onrender.com", "glitch.me", "repl.co", "replit.app",
    "blogspot.com", "wordpress.com", "weebly.com", "wixsite.com", "webflow.io", "square.site",
    "godaddysites.com", "my.canva.site", "canva.site", "framer.app", "carrd.co", "site123.me",
    "duckdns.org", "ddns.net", "no-ip.org", "hopto.org", "zapto.org", "serveo.net",
    "ngrok.io", "ngrok-free.app", "ngrok.app", "trycloudflare.com", "loca.lt",
    "000webhostapp.com", "infinityfreeapp.com", "epizy.com", "rf.gd", "azurewebsites.net",
    "cloudfront.net", "amazonaws.com", "appspot.com", "translate.goog", "myshopify.com",
    "blob.core.windows.net", "web.core.windows.net", "surge.sh", "codeanyapp.com", "plesk.page",
}
# RFC 2606 / RFC 6761 reserved names — used by the synthetic test bench.
RESERVED_TLDS = {"example", "test", "invalid", "localhost"}


def load_suffix_file(path: str) -> None:
    """Merge a Public Suffix List file (publicsuffix.org format)."""
    section_private = False
    with open(path, encoding="utf8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            line = line.strip()
            if "BEGIN PRIVATE DOMAINS" in line:
                section_private = True
            if not line or line.startswith("//") or line.startswith("!") or "." not in line:
                continue
            (PRIVATE_SUFFIXES if section_private else MULTI_SUFFIXES).add(line.lstrip("*."))


def split_host(host: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, bool]:
    """-> (subdomain, registered_domain, suffix, on_private_suffix)."""
    labels = host.strip(".").lower().split(".")
    for n in (4, 3, 2):
        if len(labels) > n and ".".join(labels[-n:]) in PRIVATE_SUFFIXES:
            return ".".join(labels[:-n - 1]), ".".join(labels[-n - 1:]), ".".join(labels[-n:]), True
    n = 1
    for k in (3, 2):
        if len(labels) > k and ".".join(labels[-k:]) in MULTI_SUFFIXES:
            n = k
            break
    if len(labels) <= n:
        return "", host.lower(), ".".join(labels[-n:]), False
    return ".".join(labels[:-n - 1]), ".".join(labels[-n - 1:]), ".".join(labels[-n:]), False

    suspicious_threshold: float = 0.40

"""Additive evidence scorer. score = sigmoid(bias + sum(weights)).

Because the model is additive, the per-evidence contributions shown to the
analyst ARE the model — not a post-hoc approximation of it.

Decision guards (security constraints, independent of weights):
 1. `malicious` requires an actionable vector (link / contact / payee) or an
    explicit credential request. Tone alone can never convict a message.
 2. Advisory evidence (optional ML/LLM plug-ins) is capped and can never be
    the reason a verdict reaches `malicious`."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from ..models import Evidence
from .policy import Policy


def sigmoid(x: float) -> float:
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x)) if x >= 0 else math.exp(x) / (1.0 + math.exp(x))


def score(evidence: list[Evidence], policy: Policy, has_vector: bool) -> tuple[float, float, str, str | None]:
    """Assigns weights in place. -> (probability, logit, verdict, guard_applied)."""
    core = adv = 0.0
    for e in evidence:
        if e.source == "advisory":
            e.weight = max(-policy.advisory_cap, min(policy.advisory_cap, float(e.detail.get("weight", 0.0))))
            adv += e.weight
        else:
            e.weight = policy.weights.get(e.id, 0.0)
            core += e.weight
    adv = max(-policy.advisory_cap, min(policy.advisory_cap, adv))
    logit = policy.bias + core + adv
    p, p_core = sigmoid(logit), sigmoid(policy.bias + core)

    def band(x: float) -> str:
        return "malicious" if x >= policy.malicious_threshold else "suspicious" if x >= policy.suspicious_threshold else "benign"

    verdict, guard = band(p), None
    if verdict == "malicious":
        if band(p_core) != "malicious":
            verdict, guard = "suspicious", "advisory_cannot_convict"
        elif not has_vector and not any(e.id == "tactic.credential_request" for e in evidence):
            verdict, guard = "suspicious", "no_actionable_vector"
    return p, logit, verdict, guard

Each stage is the actual intermediate text produced by the pipeline functions
(`text.clean`, the language pack's `fold`, `privacy.redact`), with counts of
what changed. Nothing here re-implements the pipeline; it re-runs it and
records the intermediate states so they can be shown to an analyst."""

from ..text import INVISIBLE, clean, script_profile

_TASHKEEL = {chr(c) for c in list(range(0x064B, 0x0660)) + [0x0670, 0x0640]}
_HAMZA_ETC = set("أإآٱؤئىة")
_LOOKALIKE = set("کڪیېێےەہھۀۃ")


def _count(text: str, chars: set) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    hits = [c for c in text if c in chars]
    return len(hits), sorted(set(hits))[:8]


def trace(text: str, analysis: Analysis) -> dict:

    inv, _ = _count(text, set(INVISIBLE))
    dig, dig_ex = _count(text, _AR_DIGITS)
    nfkc = sum(1 for c in text if ord(c) > 0x7F and c not in INVISIBLE and c not in _AR_DIGITS
               and unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", c) != c)
    cleaned, _ = clean(text)
    stages.append({"id": "original", "title": "النص الأصلي كما وصل", "text": text, "changes": []})
    stages.append({"id": "clean", "title": "تنظيف محايد لغويًا", "text": cleaned.text, "changes": [
        c for c in (
            {"kind": "invisible_removed", "label": "أحرف غير مرئية حُذفت", "count": inv},
            {"kind": "digits_folded", "label": "أرقام عربية-هندية وُحّدت", "count": dig, "examples": dig_ex},
            {"kind": "nfkc", "label": "أشكال عرض/حروف مزخرفة وُحّدت (NFKC)", "count": nfkc},
        ) if c["count"]]})
    packs = select_packs(script_profile(cleaned.text))
    if packs and packs[0].code == "ar":
        folded, ev = packs[0].fold(cleaned)
        tk, _ = _count(cleaned.text, _TASHKEEL)
        hz, hz_ex = _count(cleaned.text, _HAMZA_ETC)
        lk, lk_ex = _count(cleaned.text, _LOOKALIKE)
        spaced = sum(len(e.spans) for e in ev if e.id == "obfuscation.spaced_letters")
        stages.append({"id": "fold", "title": "توحيد الإملاء العربي وكشف التمويه", "text": folded.text, "changes": [
            c for c in (
                {"kind": "diacritics", "label": "تشكيل وتطويل حُذف", "count": tk},
                {"kind": "orthography", "label": "همزات وتاء مربوطة وألف مقصورة وُحّدت", "count": hz, "examples": hz_ex},
                {"kind": "lookalike", "label": "حروف فارسية/أردية شبيهة رُدّت إلى العربية", "count": lk, "examples": lk_ex},
                {"kind": "spaced", "label": "كلمات مفككة الأحرف أُعيد ضمّها", "count": spaced},

        folded, _ = packs[0].fold(cleaned)
        stages.append({"id": "fold", "title": f"توحيد خاص بلغة {packs[0].code}", "text": folded.text, "changes": []})

            {"kind": "code", "label": "رموز تحقق طُمست", "count": counts["code"]},
            {"kind": "national_id", "label": "أرقام هوية طُمست", "count": counts["national_id"]},
        ) if c["count"]]})
    return {"stages": stages, "language": analysis.language, "variety": analysis.variety.to_dict()}
